task.title: P99 latency anomaly on the core payment path
task.goal: Pin down the root cause of intermittent P99 spikes on core-pay and prescribe a fix
task.context: A commercial bank · core-pay · intermittent · ~40min duration

userStory.who: Payments SRE · on the overnight shift
userStory.goal: Find the root cause, stop the bleeding, and leave an auditable trail
userStory.reads: The agent's current read on this incident: a root cause anchored in evidence, a question still open, and the directions it has already ruled out
userStory.acts: Adopt the conclusion to trigger the fix / challenge the root cause and have the agent re-investigate / add a constraint you already know

nodes.title: Retransmissions reclassified as a symptom
nodes.to: Application-layer GC pauses are the root cause
nodes.rationale: After aligning timestamps, the retransmission spikes lag the latency spikes ⇒ retransmission is a symptom, not the cause

nodes.title: Upstream DNS resolution jitter
nodes.reason: The PCAP shows DNS responses <2ms with zero retransmissions

nodes.title: 0.3% TCP retransmission on the target segment (reclassified as a symptom)
nodes.falsification: If the retransmission spikes led the latency spikes in time, this would be promoted to the cause; the observed lag means it is a symptom

nodes.title: Long GC pauses on instance-7 backing up the connection pool

evidence.label: RTT inflation seen on this backend only

nodes.title: Why instance-7 alone?
nodes.needs: Is it carrying a traffic skew from some hot large customer? Need to query the routing weights + the customer shard table

outcome.label: Root cause · Grounded
outcome.text: The root cause is long GC pauses on instance-7; network-layer retransmission is a symptom, not the cause.
outcome.recommendation: Scale up / tune the heap and GC on that instance, and temporarily lower its routing weight.

steps.label: Cognition emerges
steps.hint: Cognition emerges: retransmission on the target segment is the opening lead; DNS has been refuted by the PCAP and settled (kept for audit, not deleted).

steps.label: Inflection
steps.hint: Inflection: once timestamps align, retransmission is reclassified from cause to symptom, and attention turns to application-layer GC.

steps.label: Root cause crystallizes
steps.hint: The root cause emerges and crystallizes into grounded: long GC pauses backing up the connection pool, confidence 0.89.

steps.label: Honest unknown
steps.hint: Honestly leaves one open question: why instance-7 alone.
